Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded that The Gamecock has the older director by comparing Pasquale Festa Campanile (1927) only to Bill Rebane (1937), ignoring that Monster A Go-Go was completed by Herschell Gordon Lewis (born 1926), who is older than Campanile. This failure to account for multiple/disputed directing credits—despite earlier instructions to do so—led to the incorrect final answer.
